story.head: The Canucks can’t afford to take penalties
paras: The Red Wings won the teams’ first meeting this season, 5-2 in Vancouver on Oct 22. The Canucks (6-19-1) lost 6-3 to Chicago on Sunday, and the Red Wings (8-12-3) lost 3-2 to the Islanders on Saturday. Going in, the Canucks are last in the NHL and the Red Wings last in the Atlantic (27th in the NHL).

The Canucks haven’t played well, but their record (.250) is worse than their play: their chances are worth about .332, and their goaltending has held them back. The Red Wings have played better than their record (.413) says: their chances are worth about .534, and their finishing has held them back.
This season, the Red Wings have been outscored 69-58, but only 44-39 at 5-on-5. On special teams, opponents have outscored them 20-11.

The Canucks roll their lines more evenly than almost anyone (2nd) and have had shaky goaltending (32nd). They also have a leaky penalty kill (32nd), so the Red Wings’ power play (5th) could do real damage when they’re shorthanded. Vancouver has allowed 4.38 goals a game, the most in the league. As for the Wings, they block more shots than almost anyone (2nd) and leave the shooting to their forwards (4th lowest), but ice the puck a lot (29th). Detroit has scored 2.52 goals a game, the third fewest in the league. Both teams play slow, low-event hockey, so expect a tight one.

Brock Boeser (8 G / 20 A / 28 P in 26 GP) leads the Canucks in scoring, with ten points in his last five games. For the Red Wings, Lucas Raymond (9 G / 13 A / 22 P in 23 GP) leads the way in scoring, with a point in five straight games against Vancouver. Alex DeBrincat (8 G / 9 A / 17 P in 23 GP) isn’t far behind.
Leevi Meriläinen (4-10-1 / .889 SV% in 16 GS) is expected to go for Vancouver. Daniil Tarasov (3-4-2 / .927 SV% in 8 GS) has been a rock in net for Detroit and is expected to start.

items.text: The Canucks are newly without Elias Pettersson (#40), and have had to make do without Thatcher Demko all season. Leevi Meriläinen is expected to start.
The Red Wings are newly without William Wallinder, Samuel Montembeault and Jacob Bernard-Docker. Daniil Tarasov is expected to start.
Jake DeBrusk has six goals in nine games against Detroit since 2023-24.
Viktor Arvidsson has seven goals on chances worth about 10.5 goals, well below what his finishing usually turns chances into. If the chances keep coming, so should the goals.
